retain_custom_instructions: Every extracted fact MUST be fully self-contained and understandable with zero surrounding context. Rules: (1) Resolve every pronoun and indirect reference ('it', 'both', 'this', 'the task', 'the user', 'assistant') to the specific named entity, person, project, or artifact it denotes; if the referent cannot be resolved from the conversation, DO NOT extract the fact. (2) Extract durable knowledge only: facts about the business, its customers, projects, decisions, people, tools, and preferences. (3) Do NOT extract conversational mechanics (who asked what, that a reply was requested, apologies, retries, acknowledgements), assistant self-description, or test/probe/smoke interactions. (4) Prefer FEWER, RICHER facts: merge closely related statements about the same entity into one complete fact instead of several fragments. (5) Never extract two facts that restate the same information.
